name: webeyes
description: Lets Claude Code watch videos: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram reels, X, Twitch, Vimeo and 1000+ sites. Transcript with timestamps plus frames.

cookies_browser.title: Cookies browser
cookies_browser.description: Optional. Browser whose logged-in session is used for posts that need login (Instagram, TikTok): chrome, firefox, edge, brave, chromium, safari. Empty = no cookies.

whisper_model.title: Whisper model
whisper_model.description: Speech-to-text model for videos without subtitles. Bigger is more accurate and slower.
